description: Score the readability of an Informed Consent Form (ICF) text. Returns Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Flesch Reading Ease, Gunning Fog Index, SMOG Grade, plus per-sentence breakdown identifying the worst offenders, medical-jargon detection with plain-language alternatives, and a pass/borderline/fail verdict vs a target grade level (default 8 per FDA / NIH guidance). Pairs with irb_review when planning a study — investigators paste the ICF draft, get back a concrete rewrite list. Pure logic, no external API.

ai_disclosure_level.description: AI assistance disclosure level. "off" = no disclosure; "standard" = default (model/tools/sources/date + human-review reminder); "submission" = adds ISPOR ELEVATE-GenAI citation. Default is tool-specific.

icf_text.description: The ICF body text. Plain text or markdown both work.

jargon_check.description: Whether to run the medical-jargon dictionary lookup. Default true.

target_grade_level.description: Target US grade level for FKGL pass verdict. FDA/NIH typically 8; some IRBs use 6 (stricter).

name: icf.readability_check
